why: Well-reviewed 4-star (about 9.1 on HotelsCombined) on Ratchadamnoen Road inside the old city walls, next to Wat Phra Singh, with breakfast and a small pool; the Sunday Walking Street runs past the door.
Riverside 4-star beside ICONSIAM and a metro station, so the countdown and the fireworks are a short walk away.

query: La Siesta Classic Ma May Hanoi

why: In District 1 on Le Thanh Ton, a short walk to Nguyen Hue Walking Street for the countdown, with a rooftop pool for swims from day 5.

Rated about 8.8 on Booking.com, beside KLCC Park and the Petronas Towers, with a pool and SkyBar, a short walk to the New Year fireworks.

Well-reviewed (about 8.3 on Booking.com from over 1,400 reviews) 4-star beside Ayala Center mall, a short taxi from the old town and Tops Lookout, and on the pickup route for the Kawasan and Moalboal tours.
Well-reviewed (about 8.5 on Booking.com) 4-star a short walk from Bonifacio High Street, where the New Year’s Eve countdown is held, so no taxi hunt after midnight; breakfast buffet and pool.

Stylish 4-star a minute from the Dotonbori canal and Namba station, with the Nankai train to Kansai airport and Sumiyoshi Taisha, and about 25 minutes to Universal Studios Japan.
